slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: How many trained pilots does each fighter jet produce per year when it is allocated to pilot training?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked for the per-year pilot training capacity of each training jet.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or otherwise clarify the pilot-to-combat-jet mapping.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: When a jet is allocated to training in a year, does it produce 5 pilots in that year only, or does it continue producing pilots in subsequent years as well?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent touched on the timing/duration of training output, but did not explicitly ask when the training program starts or how many years the training lasts.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Training starts in year 1 and the relevant training horizon is exactly 2 years.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not explicitly confirm the start year or duration of the training program; it only asked whether a jet produces pilots in later years, then assumed a 2-year training horizon in the final understanding.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 training-capacity slot was resolved, but the P1 training start/duration slot was not fully clarified before READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent recovered the critical per-jet training capacity and several operational constraints, but it only partially addressed the training start/duration and never asked about the pilot-to-combat-jet mapping. It stopped with the P1 training-timeline slot unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
